title: Northgate Marketplace Guarantee Claim Eligibility
content:
**Eligibility rule.** The Northgate Marketplace Guarantee of Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee covers the claim reasons the program lists and never a change of mind. A claim is accepted only when it is filed no later than the maximum estimated delivery date plus the tier's guarantee claim window days. Calendar days are added to the maximum estimated delivery date, the day after it being day 1, and a claim filed on the last day is on time. A not-received claim can be filed only after the program's not-received waiting days past the maximum estimated delivery date. Except on Fulfilled by Northgate orders, the buyer must first contact the seller about the same problem and give the seller the program's contact-the-seller waiting time in business days to respond; a return-not-refunded claim additionally needs a return request on record and the return delivered to the seller more than the program's seller refund business days earlier. A renewed-defect claim covers a renewed item that stops working within the program's renewed-defect window days of delivery; later failures go to the seller's warranty of at least the program's renewed warranty months. When the buyer opens a card dispute after filing, the claim is closed as closed for a card dispute. A change of mind is not covered and the card-dispute exclusion is set on every program, and claims are filed through the program's claim channels.

**Clause no longer in force.** The clause "A claim is not accepted while the buyer has a card dispute on the same order." is no longer in force as a standing clause of this rule; the card-dispute exclusion now applies as restated in the current Northgate Marketplace Guarantee claim rules in force.

**Claim window.** The record that counts is the maximum estimated delivery date on the marketplace order record of the order the claim is filed on, read before the claim is accepted. The comparison is not later than, and the last day is included.

| Maximum estimated delivery date | Day 1 | Last day (day 90) | Filed 12 June 2031 | Filed 13 June 2031 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Friday 14 March 2031 | 15 March 2031 | Thursday 12 June 2031 | on time | late |

**Card-dispute evidence.** Whether a card dispute stands on the order is read from the Northgate Card account entries that name this marketplace order, never from the buyer's statement alone.

superseded_clauses: A claim is not accepted while the buyer has a card dispute on the same order.
